author: Lena Fischer
title: Incremental indexing enabled after mapping migration
body: The new mapping with explicit nested fields accepts partial document updates. Incremental indexing is on in staging and the nightly full rebuild is no longer needed there.

author: Tomi Adeyemi
title: Multi-currency request parked
body: Stripe multi-currency remains off on our account. Finance wants to keep a single settlement currency until the EU entity exists.

author: Lena Fischer
title: Synonyms for product names
body: Added a synonym list so searches for old product names still match.

author: Marcus Chen
title: Disk alert on the metrics node
body: Prometheus retention reduced from 30 to 15 days after disk hit 92%.

author: Tomi Adeyemi
title: First customers in Ireland and Portugal signed
body: Signed two Irish customers and one in Portugal this quarter. Both asked about latency from Frankfurt and data residency.

author: Tomi Adeyemi
title: Annual invoicing for enterprise
body: Enterprise customers can be billed annually in advance.

author: Sofia Rossi
title: Crash on Android 14 camera permission
body: Fixed a crash when the camera permission was denied twice.

author: Jonah Mbeki
title: SSO for Okta customers
body: SAML SSO shipped for three Okta customers.

author: Lena Fischer
title: Moved BigQuery to flat-rate slots
body: We are now on 100 flat-rate slots. Query cost no longer depends on bytes scanned or on how often jobs run.

author: Marcus Chen
title: Incident: export endpoint saturated workers
body: A tenant triggered 400 exports in ten minutes. Mitigated by scaling workers; follow-up is rate limiting.

author: Lena Fischer
title: Late-arriving events
body: Events arriving more than 48 hours late are now routed to a quarantine table.
